name: Apollo Portal Console
description: Preview: manage Apollo 2.x configuration with independently authored pages and password login. Full 1:1 parity is incomplete.
releaseNotes: 0.1.3-rc.1 Preview: fix unintended Enter-key writes on Cancel/native selectors/closed user comboboxes; retain unsaved application/editor values across language changes; restore source form grids, Namespace prefixes, cluster success state and sidebar/footer flow. Distinct Apollo Portal Console names and explicit prerelease suffix. Full all-page/all-dialog 1:1 remains FAIL; fixture-only evidence, no live Apollo or native installation acceptance. Official review/signing required.
